## Session Context (Mixx-DJ-MCP)

You have access to a Mixxx DJ controller with 12+ portmanteau tools covering deck control, library, effects, mixer, stems, transitions, skin management, vinyl control, and more.

**Before starting work:**
1. Check deck status: mixx_deck(operation="play_pause", deck=1)
2. Library search: mixx_library(operation="search", query="<topic>")
3. Preview transition suggestions: mixx_transition(operation="suggest", deck_a=1, deck_b=2)

**At end of work:**
- Save any crate/preset changes: mixx_crate(operation="create", name="<name>")
- Document playlist decisions for future sessions
